content.text:
All 18 rules were searched across the full document and the plan is submitted. Summary of where the review will focus:

**Likely deviations (redline candidates):**
- **LOL-CAP** — § 13.4 caps M&I at 3 months' fees with a 1-year suit bar and no carve-outs; our termination fees are expressly excluded from the cap, so the limitation runs one way.
- **EXCLUSIVITY / MINCOMMIT** — § 10.3(A) locks us into buying every Monthly Base Fee Service from M&I for the full 8-year Term, with the minimum feeding the termination-fee formula and no descope right.
- **T4C / LD** — § 11.1 requires one year's notice *plus* a percentage-of-Estimated-Remaining-Value fee (uncapped), and § 13.5 has us concede it is liquidated damages; § 11.2(A) charges the higher cause fee even on our own convenience exit.
- **ASSIGN** — § 22.4 lets M&I assign freely while our rights are consent-gated; § 21.11(B) shrinks M&I's obligations on our change of control; § 11.3 is redacted.
- **IP / LICENSE** — § 10.4 gives M&I ownership of custom work "even if paid for by Customer"; the only licence (§ 23.4 escrow) is Term-limited, fee-conditioned and non-transferable, with no material-breach release trigger.
- **GOVLAW** — Wisconsin law and M&I's home forum, outside the accepted list (courts, not arbitration, which helps).

**Compliant / at fallback (note only):** INDEMN (strong § 14.2(B) IP and misconduct indemnity), INSURANCE (§ 14.1, gap on E&O/cyber), WARRANTY (§ 16.1 with disclaimer and 90-day cure), RENEWAL (option, not auto-renewal — favours us), NOSOLICIT (mutual, Term-limited; no advertising carve-out), TRANSITION (§ 11.4, but no data-return mechanic), AUDIT (no vendor audit of us; § 21.8(C) report favours us), NONCOMPETE (only conventional resale limits).

**Missing:** MFN — no most-favoured-pricing language anywhere; no burden on us, so an optional ask rather than a flag.
